akhfash:4-4.t: He said ﴿إِن تَتُوبَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا﴾: He made it (قلوب, "hearts") plural because they are two out of two. «[Translator's note: i.e., one heart belonging to each of two persons; such a pair is expressed with the plural.]»

akhfash:12-12.t: And He said ﴿وَمَرْيَمَ ٱبْنَةَ عِمْرَانَ﴾ and ﴿ٱمْرَأَةَ فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ on the construction: "And Allah set forth the wife of Pharaoh and Mary as an example" (وَضَرَبَ اللهُ امْرَأَةَ فِرْعَونَ وَمَرْيَمَ مَثَلا).
